title: Second Wind | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful WaterColor Home!* Located in WaterColor
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful WaterColor Home!* Located in WaterColor's Highly Sought-After Camp District* Just One Block from Camp WaterColor-Steps from the Tennis Courts* 4 Complimentary Bikes Included* Easy Access to WaterColor Beach Club and Pools* Access to Camp WaterColor's Lazy River and Zero-Entry Pool* Spacious Screened-In Porch with Porch Swing* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Second Wind is a beautifully decorated WaterColor home located in the highly desirable Camp District. This spacious three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath retreat offers a wonderful combination of coastal charm, modern amenities, and an unbeatable location just one block from Camp WaterColor and steps from the community's tennis courts. Inside, you'll find a comfortable and inviting layout designed for families and friends. The gourmet kitchen makes it perfect for preparing everything from morning coffee to family dinners. The large screened-in porch is the perfect spot to start your morning with coffee, relax on the porch swing, or enjoy an al fresco meal surrounded by peaceful views. Second Wind is decorated in soothing coastal tones, creating a peaceful place to relax after a day of exploring 30A.Bed Setup:Primary Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedBunk Room: Two Twin Bunk BedsGuests also enjoy access to the incredible amenities of WaterColor Beach Club, including pools, dining, and drinks at WaterColor Grill and Costa Chica. Camp WaterColor is just a short walk away and features a lazy river, zero-entry pool, and The Canteen for casual dining. Enjoy everything WaterColor has to offer, from beautiful beaches and scenic bike paths to resort-style pools and excellent dining. Spend your day at the beach, float along the lazy river at Camp WaterColor, or grab a bite and enjoy a relaxing evening close to home.Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance by guests and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, decibel meters, and video surveillance, including the front door.Area Attractions: Seaside is a fantastic destination within walking distance and is most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous, but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
